SELECT ISSUE_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO Stadium_Issue ( issue_id, start_date, end_date, issue_type, reason, stadium_id ) VALUES ( #{issueId}, TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{issueType}, #{reason}, #{stadiumId} )
mapper.select: SELECT si.issue_id AS issueId, TO_CHAR(si.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(si.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, si.issue_type AS issueType, si.reason AS reason, si.stadium_id AS stadiumId, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, s.region AS region FROM Stadium_Issue si JOIN Stadium s ON s.stadium_id = si.stadium_id ORDER BY si.issue_id DESC

SELECT si.issue_id AS issueId, TO_CHAR(si.start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS startDate, TO_CHAR(si.end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS endDate, si.issue_type AS issueType, si.reason AS reason, si.stadium_id AS stadiumId, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, s.region AS region FROM Stadium_Issue si JOIN Stadium s ON s.stadium_id = si.stadium_id WHERE si.issue_id = #{issueId}

SELECT ma.apply_id AS applyId, TO_CHAR(ma.apply_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS applyDate, ma.status AS applyStatus, s.stadium_name AS stadiumName, home.club_name AS homeClubName, away.club_name AS awayClubName FROM Stadium_Issue si JOIN Stadium s ON s.stadium_id = si.stadium_id JOIN Match_Apply ma ON ma.stadium_id = si.stadium_id LEFT JOIN Club home ON home.clubOwner_key = ma.clubOwner_key LEFT JOIN Club away ON away.clubOwner_key = ma.clubOwner_key2 WHERE si.issue_id = #{issueId} AND TRUNC(ma.apply_date) BETWEEN TRUNC(si.start_date) AND TRUNC(si.end_date) ORDER BY ma.apply_date, ma.apply_id
